prompt:
Use case: HD game diffuse texture edit, production UV canvas.
Reference: the attached image is the ENTIRE original native64x64 storedRGB canvas exposed as opaqueRGB and enlarged by NEAREST8x to512x512. Original native alpha is retained separately by the game pipeline; do not infer or redesign alpha.
Edit THIS FULL image in place, producing the same complete square canvas at higher raster resolution with identical normalized positions and scale. Keep every source occupied region, empty black area, soft edge, relative shade and orientation; no zoom, crop, padding, recentering, fitting, rotating, background change or atlas repack. Full canvas edges remain at the exact source UV edges.
ONE soft pale gray paper fragment only, positioned horizontally across the middle at the exact original angles. Preserve its left narrow projection, broad body, dark diagonal existing fold near the right and tapered lower/right tail. Existing broad gray fold is the only fold; no added crease, tear, printing, outline or bright rim. It is blurred painted paper, not cloth, smoke or a sharply rendered folded paper model.
Repaint only the coarse reference pixel steps into smooth fine plain painted surface detail at the same material scale. Do not copy the enlarged square pixel blocks as surface pattern, and do not invent new artistic forms, highlights, depth, lines, folds, grain bands or components. Maintain soft original shading and dull diffuse color; no sharper contrast or raised 3D model appearance. Preserve the original black background and black gaps, do not remove weak original parts or strengthen them. Output only this full UV texture image, opaqueRGB; no text, labels, symbols, border, frame or comparison.

source_transform_recipe.operations: Native stored RGBA→opaqueRGB, wholecanvas NEAREST8x. No crop/padding/rotate/UV fitting/unpremultiply/art inserted. SourceA separately restored by root.
source_transform_recipe.inverse: ENTIRE raw LANCZOS to original4x; sourceA LANCZOS separately; scalar brightness and original native Type handling by root.
